subject: Order Form questions: tax residency, invoice routing & payment cadence
messages:
From: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@acmecloud.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@acmecloud.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 20:45:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Order Form redlines - tax / net terms / PO routing

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo. Legal and Finance at Acme reviewed the draft order form and attached a set of redlines (attached: ACME_OrderForm_Redlines_20270609.pdf). There are a few commercial items we need clarified before internal routing: 

1) Net terms: our standard is Net 45 for vendors. We redlined Net 45 in the attached doc. Is Redwood able to accept Net45?
2) VAT / Taxes: please confirm whether Redwood will issue invoices VAT exclusive, and whether Acme should reverse-charge or Redwood will register for VAT in the EU (we have EU subsidiaries).
3) Withholding: our tax team asked that Acme may withhold local taxes if applicable — please advise if Redwood can gross-up or provide tax residency certificates.
4) Invoice routing: AP wants invoices sent to ap@acmecloud.com and requires a PO number on every invoice. Can Redwood accept PO-based invoicing?
5) Minimum commit schedule: we asked for quarterly breakouts of the committed spend (we included a table in the PDF).

We'd like to close commercial redlines this week if possible. Can you loop in finance and legal on your side and propose a short path to agreement?

Thanks,

Sophie Lee
Head of Cloud Procurement
Acme Cloud

Attachments: ACME_OrderForm_Redlines_20270609.pdf (pdf)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 21:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines - tax / net terms / PO routing

Hi Sophie — thanks for sending the redlines and the table. I’ll summarize below and propose next steps so we can get this to your signatory team quickly. Looping in Legal (Marissa) and Finance (Ben) to confirm internal constraints.

Summary of asks from Acme: 
- Net 45 payment terms (redlined)
- PO requirement on all invoices; AP routing to ap@acmecloud.com
- Withholding allowed by Acme; request for tax residency evidence
- Quarterly minimum commit breakdown
- VAT treatment for EU invoices

Proposed next steps from Redwood: 
1) Legal review: Marissa to propose language for Taxes & Withholding and PO clause.
2) Finance check: Ben to confirm whether Redwood can accept Net45 for this deal or if we need Net30 (or credit protections).
3) Commercial: I can accept the quarterly commit table but need to confirm billing cadence — proposal: quarterly invoices in arrears for committed tranches; any overage billed monthly.
4) Timeline: we can turn an updated order form (with tracked redlines) in 24 hours once Legal confirms wording.

Ben/Marissa — two specific asks to help us close quickly: 
- Marissa: suggested replacement wording for Withholding and Tax residency obligations (so Acme doesn’t leave a tax hang).
- Ben: confirm if finance can process Net45 and whether a PO-only requirement affects our billing automation.

Sophie — if this path looks OK I’ll get an updated draft to you tomorrow and propose a 30-minute sync to finalize.

—Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@acmecloud.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Order Form redlines - tax / net terms / PO routing

Thanks for the loop, Aditya. I reviewed Acme’s redlines and propose the following commercial/legal approach (high level):

1) Taxes and Withholding (proposed language):
- Customer shall be responsible for any taxes, duties or similar governmental charges ("Taxes") imposed on the amounts payable under this Order Form, except for taxes based on Redwood’s net income.
- If applicable law requires Customer to withhold taxes from payments to Redwood, Customer shall: (a) promptly notify Redwood in writing; (b) withhold only the amount legally required; and (c) provide Redwood with original or certified copies of any tax receipts or certificates that evidence the withholding. Redwood will cooperate to facilitate any available tax relief (e.g., treaty claims) but will not gross-up amounts absent a separate agreement.

2) Net terms: if Acme requires Net45, we need to include either (a) a one-time implementation charge or (b) an upfront partial prepayment to mitigate cash flow (industry standard for larger Net terms). Alternatively, Redwood can accept Net45 provided we include a 1.5% monthly interest on late amounts and a credit hold trigger at 60+ days. Sales to confirm preference.

3) PO requirement: Acceptable provided the PO is issued within 7 days of invoice date and includes the referencing deal id. If Acme requires PO before any invoice is valid, we need a short clause that allows Redwood to issue pro forma invoices for sign-off to avoid billing delays.

4) Minimum commit granularity: I suggest we accept the quarterly schedule but add an explicit clause for proration and crediting if commits are not met. Also include an early termination / true-up calculation.

Attachments: I’ll drop a short redline summary workbook to highlight the legal-friendly language and the couple of clauses that require business opt-ins.

I’m attaching: redline_summary_20270610.xlsx (summary + suggested language).

-Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Order Form redlines - tax / net terms / PO routing

Adding finance perspective: 

- Net45 impact: Net45 materially increases DSO for this account. Finance can accept Net45 for the annual committed amount only if Acme either: (a) provides a 25% upfront payment for the first quarter; or (b) provides a bank guarantee / credit approval. Otherwise we need Net30.
- PO / routing: AP email is fine. We need a sample PO (format) to ensure our billing system maps fields correctly. Please ask Acme to send a typical PO template to ap@redwood.com.
- VAT / reverse charge: For EU invoices, finance needs clarity on which legal entity of Acme will be billed (Acme EU Ltd vs Acme Inc). If Acme claims reverse charge, they must provide VAT registration numbers and reverse-charge declaration on the PO.
- Withholding: Finance cannot gross-up. If Acme withholds, they must provide official withholding tax receipts and Redwood will credit for net amounts; any withholdings that exceed legal requirements will be disputed.

I’ve added a DocuSign envelope link for the current order form draft (will update after Marissa’s edits): https://www.docusign.com/envelopes/detail/0A1B2C3D

Ben Carter
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 16:30:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Order Form redlines - tax / net terms / PO routing (next steps)

Sophie — thanks for your patience. Based on internal review here is a pragmatic path to closure so we can get you onboarded this quarter: 

1) Net terms: Redwood prefers Net30. If Acme needs Net45, we can accept Net45 provided one of the following is completed before first invoice: (a) 25% prepay of Q1 committed amount, or (b) signed credit approval form (we can start that process if needed). Please confirm which you prefer.

2) Taxes & Withholding: Redwood will issue VAT-exclusive invoices when requested. For EU reverse-charge we require Acme’s VAT number and reverse-charge declaration on the PO. If Acme is required to withhold local tax, please provide certified withholding tax receipts within 30 days of payment; Redwood will not gross-up without a separate agreement.

3) Invoice routing & PO: We will route invoices to ap@acmecloud.com. Please confirm your AP contact name and provide a sample PO format. Our billing team requires a PO number on the invoice for automated processing; if a PO is delayed we can issue a pro forma invoice for PO approval but final billing will wait until PO is received (see Marissa’s proposed 7-day window).

4) Minimum commit cadence: Redwood accepts the quarterly commit table with a 30-day true-up after each quarter. Any shortfall will be credited as described in the order form (I will include Marissa’s true-up wording).

5) Timeline: Marissa will circulate an updated draft Order Form (tracked) by tomorrow morning. If Acme confirms PO sample, VAT info and Net-terms preference today we can aim for signature by end of week and billing to start on the agreed kickoff date.

Please confirm the Net45 preference vs Net30, and send the PO template and VAT/registration details to ap@redwood.com. I’ll attach the updated draft once Marissa posts it.

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this up.

—Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
